crossRefs.note: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;

translations.web: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
translations.bsb: His bones are tubes of bronze; his limbs are rods of iron.
translations.kjv: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
translations.asv: His bones are as tubes of brass; His limbs are like bars of iron.
